blocks.en: Notice on Misconduct in Course Registration
blocks.ko: 수강신청 부정행위 관련 알림

blocks.en: □ Related School Rules and Regulations
blocks.ko: □ 관련 학칙 및 규정

blocks.en: ❍ School Rules (학칙), Article 107 (Disciplinary Action)
blocks.ko: ❍ 학칙 제107조(징계)

blocks.en: ① The President may take disciplinary action against a student who violates these School Rules or acts in a way that is not proper for a student.
blocks.ko: ① 총장은 학생이 이 학칙을 위반하거나 학생의 본분에 어긋난 행위를 하였을 때에는 징계할 수 있다.

blocks.en: ❍ Regulations on Student Disciplinary Procedures, etc., Article 2 (Grounds for Disciplinary Action and Person Authorized to Take Disciplinary Action)
blocks.ko: ❍ 학생 징계 절차 등에 관한 규정 제2조(징계사유 및 징계권자)

blocks.en: The President takes disciplinary action against any person who falls under one of the following items, after review and decision by the Seoul National University Student Disciplinary Committee (hereinafter the "Committee").
blocks.ko: 총장은 다음 각호의 1에 해당하는 자를 서울대학교학생징계위원회(이하 “위원회”라 한다)의 심의·의결에 의하여 징계한다.

blocks.en: 1. A person who commits misconduct related to academic work
blocks.ko: 1. 학업과 관련한 부정행위자

blocks.en: 3. A person who obstructs or interferes with academic administration work
blocks.ko: 3. 학사 업무 수행을 방해하거나 지장을 주는 행위를 한 자

blocks.en: 7. A person who acts in a way that is not proper for a student by improperly using on-campus computers, communication networks, data, software, etc., or by interfering with their operation
blocks.ko: 7. 학내 컴퓨터 · 통신망 · 데이터 · 소프트웨어 등을 부당하게 사용하거나 그 운용을 방해함으로써 학생의 본분에 어긋난 행위를 한 자

blocks.en: 9. A person who violates the School Rules or other regulations (including all types of rules)
blocks.ko: 9. 학칙 등 제규정(각종 규범 포함)을 위반한 자

blocks.en: □ Types and Cases of Misconduct in Course Registration
blocks.ko: □ 수강신청 관련 부정행위 유형 및 사례

blocks.en: ❍ Logging in to the course registration website with the same student account at the same time from several access environments (for example, a PC and a mobile device) or from different types of web browsers, which puts extra load on the server and lets the student take course seats first
blocks.ko: ❍ 동일 학생 계정에 대해 여러 접속환경(PC와 모바일 등), 또는 종류가 다른 웹 브라우저에서 수강신청 사이트에 동시 접속하여 서버 부하 유발 및 수강신청 교과목 선점

blocks.en: → 1st semester of the 2016 academic year: a student from ○○ College was caught and given a strict warning (disciplinary action if caught again)
blocks.ko: → 2016학년도 1학기, ○○대학 소속 학생 적발 및 엄중 경고(차회 적발시 징계)

blocks.en: ❍ Using a program that repeats the same action automatically (commonly called a "macro") to make more registration attempts in the same time than a normal user can, which takes away the chance of normal users
blocks.ko: ❍ 동일 행동 반복 수행 프로그램(통칭 “매크로”)을 사용하여 동일 시간 내에 일반적인 신청 횟수보다 많은 신청 시도를 함으로써 정상 이용자의 기회 박탈

blocks.en: → 1st semester of the 2017 academic year: a student from ○○ College was caught and the student's course registration record was cancelled
blocks.ko: → 2017학년도 1학기, ○○대학 소속 학생 적발 및 수강신청 내역 취소 처리

blocks.en: → 1st semester of the 2018 academic year: about 30 students were caught, and measures such as cancelling their course registration records were taken
blocks.ko: → 2018학년도 1학기, 30여명 학생 적발 및 수강신청 내역 취소 등 조치 처리

blocks.en: ❍ Using an improper program that can view other students' registration records or take courses they have registered for, which harms fairness
blocks.ko: ❍ 다른 학생의 신청내역을 열람하거나, 신청 교과목을 탈취할 수 있는 부적정 프로그램의 사용으로 공정성을 침해

blocks.en: → 1st semester of the 2016 academic year: a student from ○○ College was caught and given a fixed-term suspension (유기정학, suspension from school for a set period)
blocks.ko: → 2016학년도 1학기, ○○대학 소속 학생 적발 및 유기정학 처리

blocks.en: Manual for Course Overlap Request 중복수강신청 (For Students) — Course Overlap Request — What is a course overlap request?
blocks.ko: 중복수강신청 매뉴얼 (학생용) 중복수강신청 중복수강신청이란?

blocks.en: Overview: When a student unavoidably has to take 2 or more courses whose class times overlap, the student can register for them at the same time with the approval of the professors in charge. This system is called a course overlap request.
blocks.ko: 개요 시간표가 겹치는 2개 이상의 과목을 부득이하게 동시 수강해야 하는 경우, 담당 교원의 승인을 얻어 중복으로 수강신청하는 제도

blocks.en: ※ The course registration website does not let you register for all of these courses. A separate request and approval are needed. How to apply: ① First, complete registration for 1 of the courses. ② Then get permission* for the overlap from the professor in charge of the course you registered for in ①. * Permission: you can prove it with material that shows the professor's decision, such as an email. ③ Submit an online request for the other course on the mySNU '중복수강신청 (Course Overlap Request)' screen.
blocks.ko: ※ 수강신청 사이트에서는 모든 과목에 대한 수강신청이 불가하며, 별도 신청 및 승인이 필요함 방법 ① 1개 과목에 대한 수강신청을 먼저 완료한 후, ② ①에서 수강신청한 과목의 담당 교원으로부터 중복수강신청 허가*를 받아서 * 허가: 이메일 등 담당 교원의 의사 확인이 가능한 자료로 증빙 가능 ③ mySNU ‘중복수강신청’화면에서 다른 교과목에 대해 전산 신청

blocks.en: Period: (1st) Course registration period; (2nd) Course change period. A separate notice will give the details. Course Overlap Request Manual — Course Registration Website
blocks.ko: 기간 (1차) 수강신청 기간 (2차) 수강신청 변경기간 중 별도 공지함 중복수강신청 매뉴얼 수강신청사이트

blocks.en: Course registration: First register for 1 of the courses you want to take with overlapping times. (You can also do this during the course change period or through 정원외 (over-quota) registration.) Course Overlap Request Manual — mySNU
blocks.ko: 수강신청 중복수강신청을 희망하는 과목 중 1개를 먼저 수강신청함(수강신청 변경, 정원외도 가능) 중복수강신청 매뉴얼 mySNU

blocks.en: Menu: 학사정보 (Academic Information) > 수업/성적 (Classes/Grades) > 수업 (Classes) > 중복수강신청 (Course Overlap Request), then click '추가 (Add)'. Course Overlap Request Manual — mySNU

blocks.en: Select a course: Click the magnifying glass button and select the class you want to request as an overlap. Course Overlap Request Manual — mySNU
blocks.ko: 과목선택 돋보기 버튼 클릭하여 중복수강신청할 강좌 선택 중복수강신청 매뉴얼 mySNU

blocks.en: Attach evidence: Check the details of the (already) registered course that overlaps with the requested class. Attach evidence that the professor in charge of that course allows the overlap, then return to the previous screen.

blocks.en: ※ Evidence: an email, message, etc. in which the professor in charge of the class approves the course overlap request. Course Overlap Request Manual — mySNU
blocks.ko: ※ 증빙자료: 수업담당교원이 중복수강신청을 승인하는 내용의 이메일, 메시지 등 중복수강신청 매뉴얼 mySNU

blocks.en: Apply: Check your course overlap request details one last time, then click the '신청 (Apply)' button. Q&A Q) How can I check the result of my course overlap request? A) After the processing completion date announced in the notice, you can check it yourself in your course registration record. (mySNU - 학사정보시스템 (Academic Information System) - 수업/성적 (Classes/Grades) - 수업 (Classes) - 나의수강내역 (My Course Registration Record))
blocks.ko: 신청 중복수강신청내역 최종 확인 후 신청버튼 클릭 Q&A Q) 중복수강신청 처리결과는 어떻게 확인할 수 있나요? A) 공지를 통해 안내된 처리완료일정 이후 본인의 수강신청내역에서 직접 확인하실 수 있습니다. (mySNU-학사정보시스템-수업/성적-수업-나의수강내역)

blocks.en: Q) Can I request an overlap for 3 or more courses? A) Yes, you can apply. However, you must first register for 1 course, and then register for the other courses through Course Overlap Request on mySNU. In this case, you need approval from the professors of all the courses.
blocks.ko: Q) 3개 이상의 교과목을 중복수강신청할 수 있나요? A) 신청은 가능합니다. 다만 1개의 교과목을 먼저 수강신청한 후, mySNU 중복수강신청을 통해 나머지 교 과목을 수강신청하셔야 합니다. 이 때 모든 교과목의 교원 승인이 필요합니다.

blocks.en: - Course you have already registered for: an email or message from the professor in charge that shows approval of the course overlap request

blocks.en: Approval processing: · Overlapping class: among the classes the student has already registered for, a class whose time partly overlaps with the professor's own class → the student has already received approval for the overlap from the professor in charge of that class (the approval can be checked through the attached evidence). ☞ Check the details of the overlapping class, judge whether the student can take both classes, and then decide whether to approve. Manual for Course Overlap Request (For Professors) Manual — mySNU
blocks.ko: 승인처리 ·겹치는 강좌: 학생이 이미 수강신청을 완료한 강좌 중, 수업시간이 교원의 담당강좌 와 일부 겹치는 강좌 → 해당 수업의 담당교원으로부터 중복수강을 승인받은 상태 (증빙자료를 통해 승인내역 확인 가능) ☞ 겹치는 강좌의 상세정보를 확인 후 중복수강 가능여부를 판단하여 승인여부 결 정 Manual for Course Overlap Request (For Professors) Manual mySNU

Attachment 1-3. Card News on Changes to the Course Registration System to Prevent Course Trading (강의매매, selling or buying course seats)
